The fits are reviewed by eye, page by page, on claude.ai Artifacts. They are private: they open only for their owner and for people the owner has shared them with. Each page lists every window, order or atlas page with quality filters, draws the observed spectrum, the model and the residual, and keeps good / suspect / reject marks.
